image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a guenon monkey (likely a Diana or similar species) perched on a rocky surface. The monkey has distinctive black and white facial markings, a long snout, and a mix of grey, brown, and olive fur on its body. Its long tail hangs down in the foreground, showing orange/reddish coloration at the tip. The background consists of blurred rock textures.

Eyes are forward-facing; irises appear dark brown/black, consistent with the species.
The snout is elongated and narrow, characteristic of guenons.
Ears are visible, small, and partially hidden by the facial ruff, matching the description.

The left hand gripping the rock is somewhat indistinct. The fingers merge slightly with the rock texture, lacking clear individual digit definition, which is a common AI artifact in complex grasping poses.
The background rocks have a slightly soft, dreamlike quality with inconsistent lighting direction compared to the sharp subject, suggesting potential depth map inconsistencies.
